title: 上
teacherNotes: User-approved lesson. Depends on L009 山. Use only characters learned in L001-L009 plus 上. Sentences: 我一個人上山; 山上有三個大人; 我的手小小的; 我的手上有一個小人; 有大大的山，有小小的山. For 我, use the fixed young girl character. Sentence 3 reuses the approved L007 image and audio. Sentence 5 reuses the approved L009 big/small mountain image but needs new sentence audio. Use AI sentence audio and production AI timestamp alignment.
